words.prose: {{ar:مَنَوٰةَ}} ({{tr:Manāta}}) is the named idol, but the case does important work: it is accusative under the unrepeated challenge from 53:19, so the supposed apportioner of fate is made into the object being examined. As a rare proper-name surface, it concentrates a {{ar:م ن ي}} ({{tr:m-n-y}}) field that otherwise spreads through apportionment, allotted death, wishing, and emitted semen, while local grammar and V4 keep the selected sense as the proper name Manat. That pressure is not isolated: the same root-family returns around wishing (53:24) and emission (53:46), and the pairing with the final adjective creates a rare fate-and-after/other relation. The variant {{ar:وَمَنَاءَةَ}} ({{tr:wa-Manāʾata}}) changes the sound of the name without replacing the referent, while the feminine form and two following feminine adjectives prepare the gendered allocation question in 53:21.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلثَّالِثَةَ}} ({{tr:ath-thālithata}}) is not a free number. Its feminine accusative definiteness binds it to {{ar:مَنَوٰةَ}} ({{tr:Manāta}}), so the name is described as the known third member of a familiar set. The ordinal completes the triad and changes the idol from a claimant to power into a counted position after the first two names, giving 53:21 a completed surface platform for its male/female allocation question. It also prepares the final adjective: {{ar:ٱلثَّالِثَةَ}} ({{tr:ath-thālithata}}) supplies rank, then {{ar:ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ}} ({{tr:al-ukhrā}}) turns that rank into residual otherness. The root's wider Quranic use remains in the counting register, and the resonance with the rejected phrase 'third of three' (5:73) makes triadic deity-language part of the background pressure.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ}} ({{tr:al-ukhrā}}) is the second adjective of {{ar:مَنَوٰةَ}} ({{tr:Manāta}}), feminine, definite, and accusative with the same object phrase. Even if it shades the preceding ordinal, the stronger local attachment keeps the final landing on Manat as the remaining other. The local sense is the other or remaining one after the first two idols, but the ayah-ending position lets the after/finality field of {{ar:أ خ ر}} ({{tr:ʾ-kh-r}}) be heard as pressure rather than as a replacement translation. The final adjective completes the phrase by turning 'the third' into the leftover other, and it also echoes the earlier other-descent wording (53:13) while anticipating the surah's later finality field (53:27, 53:38, 53:47). Its long final sound closes the ayah and carries the feminine surface forward into the allocation question in 53:21.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired modifiers al-thalithata al-ukhra qualify Manat as both third and other/later.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ordinal does more than locate item three: it makes the named entrant complete a prior pair, while 'other/later' simultaneously distinguishes and demotes that completion to one more member.

activation_trace.role: The third-who-completes-two supplies both ordinal position and the act that closes a pair into a triad.

activation_trace.role: The third hearthstone literally joins two supports and functionally recasts Manat as the stabilizing brace of a three-point arrangement.

changed_reading.before: The verse appends a third name.
changed_reading.after: The verse may expose the third name as the rear brace that lets the whole cultic arrangement appear stable.

activation_trace.role: The number three fixes the terminal position in the local count.
Deferral to a later time makes the final member sound belated rather than climactic.
The physical rear supplies the catalog-tail image and shifts hierarchy into spatial placement.

strongest_changes: The ordinal list became an epistemic exhibit tested by the surah's prior discipline of seeing.
The third became an allotted share inside the crooked male/female division rather than an intrinsic sacred rank.
The triad became a socially assembled composite held together by names, ancestry, conjecture, and desire without compelling warrant.
Al-ukhra expanded from local differentiation into a first/later axis that makes Manat a belated relative member.
The added third became a presumed mediator whose efficacy is blocked by the later permission condition.
summary.what_was_special: Two ordinary modifiers generated unusually different mechanisms at once: completion, partition, support, fabrication, temporal demotion, and individuation. Most strikingly, context m-n-y reactivated the otherwise unroot-tagged name Manat through wishing, measure, generation, and the inventory's explicit idol-name branch, while the final prostration reversed the tripod's apparent stability.
remaining_uncertainties: The partitive, hearthstone, rope, residue, and race branches are real inventory activations but increasingly distant from the surface ordinal.
The Manat/m-n-y bridge may be deliberate root-field resonance or only a productive hermetic echo; it should not be presented as a forced focus etymology.
Al-ukhra may carry temporal/rear force, or may remain an emphatic local differentiator despite the repeated first/later pattern.
The countercatalogue depends on a legitimate but non-dominant split mapping and therefore remains exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The third completes a counted series.** ث ل ث B003 supplies being third or completing two into three; ء خ ر B001 supplies another/later item. The fixed ayah extends 53:19 rather than standing syntactically alone. I infer that enumeration exposes the objects as members of an arranged inventory; the ayah reads as cataloguing a humanly ordered set.
2. **“The other” as demotion to one more item.** ء خ ر B001 can mean other than the first, while ث ل ث B001 supplies numerical three. In contrast to the singular lordship and signs of 53:18, I infer that ordinal placement strips the named object of uniqueness; it reads as merely the later third in a series.
3. **A deferred remainder.** ء خ ر B002 supplies postponement and what remains to the end. Exploratorily, the third named item arrives after the first two across the ayah boundary. I infer that delayed placement rhetorically makes it an appended remainder; the ayah reads with slight catalogic deflation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 53:45 later places male and female inside ز و ج B001 under one creator, contrasting created pairing with this humanly numbered divine catalog. The later structure makes the third item's ordinal placement look even more constructed and non-unique.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A humanly serialized taxonomy.** `ث ل ث B003` supplies being third or making a third, and `ء خ ر B001` supplies what is later or other than the first. The ordinal plus `الأخرى` presents the named item as an appended member of a series; 53:23 then explicitly exposes names assigned by people and ancestors. The packet supplies serial position, otherness, and inherited naming; I infer the arrow repeated naming -> manufactured category stability. The fixed ayah reads as taxonomy under examination, not a neutral continuation of a list.

2. **The appended “other” is overtaken by total temporal ownership.** `ء خ ر B001` also carries lateness, and 53:25 pairs `الآخرة` with `الأولى`. The packet supplies an “other/later” item and, five ayat later, ownership of later and first; I infer the arrow ownership of both temporal poles -> collapse of any independent appended domain. The fixed epithet consequently becomes vulnerable to the wider first/last frame.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - Later 53:23-25 showed that the “third other” belongs to a manufactured naming series and then placed every later/first pole under a larger ownership frame.

Belirli bağlamlarda bir topluluğun son kesimi veya ardından hiçbir şey gelmeyen nihai varlık anlatılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi daha sonraya bırakma, bir öznenin geride kalması, vadeli satış ve ürününü hasadın sonuna dek taşıyan hurma örneklerini aynı zaman sonralığı çevresinde toplar. Geçişlilik ve bağlama bağlı örnekler korunarak dal kimliği tutarlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi olağan, belirlenmiş veya başka bir şeye göre daha sonraki bir zamana bırakmak ya da bir öznenin bu biçimde geride kalmasıdır. Vadeyi ileri alma ve bir ürünün hasadın sonuna kadar kalması bunun bağlama bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir olay veya öğe daha sonraki zamana bırakılır ya da bir özne zaman veya sıra bakımından geride kalır.
Satış bağlamında ödeme vadesinin ileri bir tarihe bırakılması anlatılır.
Zaman belirten kullanımda birini ancak geç bir dönemde tanıma veya birinin geç gelmesi anlatılır.
Ürünü hasat döneminin sonuna kadar üzerinde kalan bir hurma ağacı, gecikmiş kalışın somut örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar, öne almanın karşıtı olarak daha sonraya bırakmayı ve geride kalmayı ortaklaştırır; vadeli satış, geç zamanda gerçekleşme ve ürünü hasadın sonuna kalan ağaç bu yapının özel kullanımlarıdır.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin önüyle karşıtlanan arka bölümü ya da arka tarafı gösterilir.
Gözde şakağa yakın arka köşe ve binek semerinde binicinin yaslandığı arka dayanak adlandırılır.
Bir nesneyi arka tarafından yarmak, arka bölüm adının ilgeçli bir yapıda kullanılmasına dayanır.
Dişi devenin öndeki iki yanıyla karşıtlanan iki arka yanı özel bir çoğul biçimle gösterilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dünya yaşamının karşısındaki ikinci varoluşu ve onun yurdunu açıkça tek bir yerleşik kavram olarak sunar. Bu kullanım, herhangi bir dişil sonraki biçimine veya sıradan zaman gecikmesine genellenemez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca ölümden sonraki ikinci yaşam düzenini ve onun dünyasını kapsar; genel sonralık ve geciktirme anlamları ayrı tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, tek başına kullanılan biçim ile öteki dünyayı belirten söz öbeğini ayırırken ikisini aynı ikinci varoluş kavramına bağlar.

concept_map.definition: İçinde yaşanılan dünya düzeninden sonra başlayacağı kabul edilen ikinci varoluş ve bu varoluşun yurdudur. Tek başına kullanılan biçim, bağlamda bu yurt ifadesinin düşürülmüş biçimi olarak işleyebilir.

facets.statement: Dünya yaşamından sonra gelen ikinci varoluş düzeni anlatılır.
Bu ikinci varoluş, içinde bulunulan dünyaya karşıt bir yurt olarak adlandırılır.
Yurt adı söylenmeden kullanılan biçim, bağlam içinde ikinci yaşam yurdunu tek başına temsil eder.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynaklı kanıt, ikinci varoluş ile onun yurdunu aynı yerleşik kavramın iki anlatımı olarak verir ve yurt adının bağlamda söylenmeden bırakılabildiğini belirtir.

source_details.summary: İkinci varoluşun yurdu tam söz öbeğiyle veya yurt adı düşürülerek tek başına anılabilir.
